data.text: [00:04]Andy, umm … we need to talk …
[00:09]Well, I was thinking … I think we need to travel separately now …
[00:15.8]Oh! Really? I’m enjoying being with you so much … I think that would be a real shame … .
[00:23]Well … yes … I like travelling with you, too … but … I want to practise my Portuguese and when I’m with you, we just speak English all the time.
[00:36.7]Oh … I promise I’ll speak Portuguese to you … .
[00:40.7]No … I don’t think that would work, do you?
